purpose: Make guide navigation and real-world place discovery more visible.
features: Entry shortcuts before the lead photograph
Whole walking route link for curated sequences only
Numbered chapter links with current-section tracking
One-time route drawing on entering the viewport and brief stop transitions
constraints: Diagrams show stop order, not geographic coordinates or scale
Boat journeys and service comparisons are not converted into walking itineraries
Google Maps URLs open the actual external map; no new Maps API key or tile service
Walking URLs contain at most three intermediate waypoints for mobile compatibility
No fabricated distances, trip durations or GPS location
Editorial publication dates are unchanged for this navigation-only feature
validation: 390px route, place, and chapter layouts checked
Keyboard Enter changes the selected stop
